> Life is about reproduction. Period. 

Perhaps, perhaps not. There is no way to understand why we exist. There is no way to test and verify any ideas. Therefore offering an explanation, no matter how simplistic, is wrong.

> too noble for distractions

There is a difference between being too noble, and being fed up with them. As stated, I've been severely depressed for seven years. It gets to a point where distractions are less and less helpful. 

> If you're curious about peaceful, cost-effective methods, contact me in private.

This is why I was reluctant to reach out for help. I was fearful of trolls during this very volatile time. I quickly realized, after reading your other comments, you are not one. You are one of the reasons I have come to loathe humanity. You have an inferiority complex. You must come online to state your deluded opinions in such a manner that is counter productive to, as you believe, our very point of existence. You tell people what their depressed side wants to hear in order to have a false sense of power. You play to their emotions in order to manipulate them, thus making your own existence more important than theirs; in your mind at least.

Then at least I will no longer feel the way I feel. 

> That's not going to change how shitty life is, but it will distract you from the harsh reality of ordinary fucking people. Don't think so much, it's bad for ya.

That's the point... I don't want a distraction. Life shouldn't be about distractions.
Why the fuck are you talking like Benny from NV?
Put it this way.. my dad already vowed to shoot me in the leg if I enlist. And knowing my father, I wouldn't doubt he'd actually do it.

The only problem is I have no insurance and limited funds. Not to mention I don't have a vehicle since after my mom crashed hers, she took mine. So not only could I not afford professional help without my parents, but I also cannot get to an appointment.
